item.title: Great weather lies ahead for Super Bowl weekend
item.description: Highs over the next few days will continue to reach the 60s. This is all thanks to a stubborn high pressure system currently parked over the region.

item.title: History of Olympic torches as the Winter Games begin in Milan Cortina
item.description: The start of the Winter Olympics is marked by the lighting of the cauldron. The Olympic torch began its journey to Milan and Cortina for the 2026 Winter Games on December 3.

item.title: Colorado nonprofit expands programs to prevent youth violence with new grant
item.description: A $45,000 grant from the Colorado Safe Futures Fund will let Joint Initiatives expand its Pathways program, helping kids build positive relationships.
